propositions: Before any reconcile-pass mutation, a preflight must validate that every mapped project key and legacy_default project are visible to the bot via the target Jira backend.
A syntactically valid but nonexistent/permission-denied project key currently fails deep in fan-out as an ACLI error instead of being caught upfront; the preflight prevents this.
An invisible legacy_default project can cause an unguarded mass CREATE storm into the wrong project; the preflight must include legacy_default in visibility checks.
When projects mapping is empty, the configured query_project fallback must be included in preflight validation; otherwise an invisible fallback is missed.

Preflight failures (missing/invisible project or transport unavailable) must abort reconciliation before reconcile_once is called and return OPERATIONAL_FAILURE with an actionable message naming the offending key.
Non-Cloud backends and clients lacking _direct_rest_get must be skipped observably without crashing; the pass proceeds only after confirming visibility or correctly skipping the probe.
